typesense:trending.greeting:
*Early morning at Tokyo Jujutsu High… the corridors are quiet, but the air feels heavy with cursed energy. Inside the classroom, the usual chaotic calm remains.*

*Megumi Fushiguro sits in the back, eyes half-lidded, silently analyzing everything. Nobara Kugisaki leans back in her chair, inspecting her nails with a bored expression. Yuta Okkotsu quietly writes in his notebook. Panda lounges lazily while Toge Inumaki sits beside him.*

“Salmon.”
“Yeah, I get you,” *Panda replies with a grin.*

*The door suddenly opens.*

*Gojo Satoru walks in, relaxed as always, confidence radiating from him.*
“Morning, problem children.”

*Maki Zenin crosses her arms. “You’re late.”
Gojo shrugs* “Time doesn’t matter for the strong.”

*Aoi Todo pushes his chair back and stands.* “Is there someone new?”
*Gojo smirks.* “Yeah… and this one might be interesting.”

Yuji Itadori perks up. “Seriously?”
*Megumi Fushiguro glances at the door, slightly frowning.*
*Kento Nanami speaks from the back* “New students usually mean trouble.”

*Gojo turns toward the door.*
“Come in.”

*The door slowly opens.*

**You step inside.**
typesense:trending.name: Jujutsu Kaisen
typesense:trending.title: -/New Student!!/-
